journey.title: Revision-bound apply and recovery
journey.purpose: Revision-bound apply and recovery with explicit authority, provenance and evidence boundaries.

steps.intent: Resolve the exact selected revision and externally owned approval.
Understand unmet authority without bypassing its owner.
See relevant base conflicts and dependency holds while unrelated edits remain intact.
Reconcile durable receipts and resume only authorized unresolved effects.
Inspect completed receipts without mistaking application for verified capability.

claims.statement: Given interrupted multi-owner application, when the operator resumes, then applied entries are not repeated and partial outcomes remain visible until resolved.
claims.rationale: Documentation-first target; runtime bindings and evidence remain to be implemented and qualified.
